description: The API key owner must own connectionId. Raw provider method, path, content type, and workspace are not accepted.

fields.name: operationId
fields.description: Exact catalog operation ID, for example sp.list_campaigns.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Documented fields for the selected operation; required by create/update operations.

fields.name: queryString
fields.description: Optional operation-specific query string without a leading ?.

fields.name: action
fields.description: preview (default) or confirm for mutations; ignored for reads.

fields.name: confirmationToken
fields.description: Single-use token required when action is confirm.
